map.为什么 Excel 打开是乱码？: Why does Excel show garbled text?
map.因为编码不匹配：中文 CSV 存成 UTF-8 时，Excel 默认按本地编码（: Because of an encoding mismatch: when a Chinese CSV is saved as UTF-8, Excel opens it with the local encoding (GBK) by default and shows garbled text. The fix is to add a UTF-8 BOM when exporting, or use Data → From Text in Excel to specify the encoding manually. Also, IDs starting with 0 and long digit strings get converted to numbers automatically, so set those columns to text format.
